statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted to offer monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page, send customers to your own thank-you page after payment, and add GST to your prices.
Following our guidance, you added the yearly price, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show on your checkout.
Following our guidance, you pasted your thank-you page link into the After purchase redirect option and saved it, and you confirmed that a test purchase took you straight to your thank-you page.
We showed you how to add a second price: open the product, go to Pricing and click Add price.
We showed you where to set the redirect: the product's Pages settings, under the After purchase redirect option.
We discussed adding GST to your prices and pointed you to a tax setting for it.
Add your privacy policy link to your checkout footer (you mentioned you would do this this week).
We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.
